# Berlitz

> > Berlitz is a global language education provider offering language training, cultural training, and professional development programs through innovative methods like Berlitz Flex and live instruction.

Founded as a pioneer in language education, Berlitz serves individuals, corporations, and government agencies with courses in English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese, and many other languages. The site features comprehensive language learning resources, pronunciation guides, vocabulary lists, and cultural insights alongside information about their flagship training programs.

- [How to write a letter in French - start to finish [formal + informal]](https://www.berlitz.com/blog/how-to-write-letter-french): French letter writing guide for formal & informal correspondence
- [How to Say You're Beautiful in French plus 76 More Compliments](https://www.berlitz.com/blog/compliments-beautiful-french): 77 French compliments including how to say beautiful in various contexts
- [French Flower Names: 108 Florals to Make Your Vocab Bloom](https://www.berlitz.com/blog/names-flowers-french-marigolds): 108 French flower names for botanical vocabulary building
